desc: Display data and index disk size for tables in the database

args.name: -e
args.value: SELECT table_name, ROUND((data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS total_mb, ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_mb, ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_mb, table_rows FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = '${HIVEPAAS_DATABASE}' ORDER BY (data_length + index_length) DESC LIMIT 20;
